about: House recipes, batch 04 (helper sA): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Christmas Glazed Ham with Orange Mustard Glaze
recipes.summary: A cooked leg ham scored and baked with an orange, mustard and brown sugar glaze, great hot or cold on Christmas Day.

items: 4kg cooked leg ham on the bone

steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Peel the rind off the ham, leaving a thin layer of fat, and score it in a diamond pattern, pressing a clove into each cross.
Warm the marmalade, sugar, mustard and juice in a pan for 3 minutes until syrupy.
Brush the ham with half the glaze and bake for 1 hour, brushing every 20 minutes until deep, sticky and golden.
notes: Christmas in summer: serve cold with salad and bread if it is hot. Ham is salty.
Food safety: a cooked ham is reheated until steaming hot at the centre (at least 70°C); refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 4 days.

recipes.title: Christmas Turkey Breast Roll with Herb Butter and Cranberry
recipes.summary: A boneless turkey breast roasted with herb butter, perfect for a smaller Christmas table.
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan). Mix the butter, thyme, garlic and zest and rub all over the turkey.
Sit it on the onion in a tray with the stock and roast for 75 minutes until golden and a thermometer in the centre reads 75°C.
Rest for 15 minutes, slice and serve with the pan juices and cranberry sauce.
notes: Contains dairy.
Food safety: turkey must reach 75°C in the centre; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Christmas Prawn and Mango Platter with Lime Mayo
recipes.summary: A cold summer-Christmas platter of cooked prawns, mango, avocado and lime mayonnaise.
steps: Arrange the lettuce on a platter and top with the mango and avocado.
Check the prawns are opaque and firm, then pile them on top and scatter over the chilli and coriander.
Stir the mayonnaise with the lime zest and juice, adding a spoonful of water until pourable, and serve alongside.
notes: Contains shellfish and egg. Keep chilled until serving.
Food safety: keep cooked prawns below 5°C and serve within 30 minutes of leaving the fridge; eat leftovers within 1 day.

recipes.title: Thanksgiving Turkey Breast with Sage Gravy and Cornbread Stuffing
recipes.summary: A smaller-scale Thanksgiving dinner using a turkey breast roll, a sage gravy and cornbread stuffing.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Rub the turkey with the butter and sage and roast on a tray for 70 minutes, until the thickest part reaches 75°C.
Soften the onion and celery in a little butter for 6 minutes, mix with the cornbread, egg and 1 cup of stock and bake in a dish alongside for 30 minutes until golden.
Rest the turkey, stir the flour into the pan juices for 1 minute, add 2 cups of stock and simmer for 5 minutes until thick for the gravy.
notes: Contains gluten, dairy and egg.
Food safety: turkey must reach 75°C at the thickest part, and stuffing baked separately until steaming hot; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Lunar New Year Steamed Whole Fish with Ginger and Spring Onion
recipes.summary: A symbolic Lunar New Year dish: a whole fish steamed and finished with sizzling oil, ginger and soy.
steps: Cook the rice. Place the fish on a heatproof plate over a steamer with half the ginger and the wine and steam for 14 minutes until the flesh is opaque and flakes near the bone.
Pour off the liquid, scatter the spring onion and remaining ginger on top and drizzle with the soy sauce and sesame oil.
Heat the vegetable oil until shimmering and pour over the fish. Serve with the coriander and rice.
notes: Contains fish, soy, sesame and gluten (from the Shaoxing wine).
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

recipes.title: Lunar New Year Longevity Noodles with Prawns and Greens
recipes.summary: Long egg noodles tossed in garlicky soy sauce with prawns, mushrooms and bok choy.
steps: Boil the noodles for 4 minutes until tender and drain. Fry the prawns in half the oil for 3 minutes until pink and set aside.
Fry the garlic and mushroom in the remaining oil for 4 minutes until golden, add the bok choy for 2 minutes until wilted.
Toss in the noodles, prawns, soy sauce, oyster sauce and sesame oil until everything is coated and scatter with spring onion.
notes: Contains shellfish, gluten, soy, egg and sesame.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

recipes.title: Eid Spiced Lamb and Rice Tray Bake
recipes.summary: A halal-friendly, fragrant tray bake of spiced lamb, rice, almonds and sultanas that feeds a crowd.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Mix the lamb, onion and spices and press into the base of a large deep tray with the oil.
Scatter over the rice, sultanas and half the almonds, pour in the hot stock and cover tightly with foil.
Bake for 45 minutes until the rice is tender and the lamb is cooked through. Scatter the parsley and remaining almonds and serve with yoghurt.
notes: Made with halal-certified meat and stock if required. Contains dairy, nuts and gluten (if stock contains it).
Food safety: lamb mince must reach 75°C with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Eid Chicken Mandi-Style Rice with Tomato Sauce
recipes.summary: Spiced chicken legs over fragrant rice with raisins and a fiery tomato salsa.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Rub the chicken with the spices and oil and roast for 45 minutes until golden and the thickest part reaches 75°C.
Meanwhile simmer the rice in the stock with raisins, covered, for 15 minutes until tender.
Mix the tomato, chilli and coriander into a salsa and serve the chicken over the rice.
notes: Made with halal chicken if required.
Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C at the thickest part with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Diwali Paneer Pea Masala with Jeera Rice
recipes.summary: A festive vegetarian main of paneer and peas in a creamy tomato masala with cumin rice.
steps: Cook the onion in the ghee for 8 minutes until golden, add the ginger, garlic and spices for 1 minute, then the tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes. Blend until smooth if you like.
Stir in the cream, paneer and peas and simmer for 6 minutes until the peas are tender.
Cook the rice with the cumin seeds for 12 minutes until tender and serve.
notes: Contains dairy. Paneer is a vegetarian cheese made without animal rennet.

recipes.title: Diwali Stuffed Capsicum with Spiced Potato and Cashews
recipes.summary: Whole capsicums stuffed with spiced potato, peas and cashews and baked until soft.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Fry the cumin seeds and onion in the oil for 5 minutes until golden, add the spices, potato, peas and cashews for 4 minutes, then the lemon and coriander.
Fill the capsicums with the mix, stand them upright in a dish with 1/4 cup of water and replace the tops.
Bake for 30 minutes until the capsicums are tender and slightly charred. Serve with the yoghurt.
notes: Contains nuts and dairy. Use dairy-free yoghurt for vegan.

recipes.title: Passover-Style Slow-Roast Lamb Shoulder with Lemon and Herbs
recipes.summary: Lamb shoulder roasted until falling apart with garlic, lemon and rosemary. Contains no flour, grains or leavening.
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C (140°C fan). Stab the lamb all over, push in the garlic, and rub with the rosemary, lemon and oil.
Place on the potato in a deep tray, add the stock, cover tightly with foil and roast for 3.5 hours.
Remove the foil, raise to 220°C (200°C fan) and roast for 20 minutes until browned and the meat shreds easily.
notes: Uses no flour, grains or leavening, but check packaged ingredients such as stock for Passover certification if you observe it.
Food safety: lamb must be cooked until tender and above 75°C; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 3 days.

recipes.title: Slow-Braised Brisket with Carrots and Onions for Passover
recipes.summary: Beef brisket braised for hours with onions, carrots and garlic until it slices easily. Uses no flour or grains.
steps: Heat the oven to 150°C (130°C fan). Brown the seasoned brisket in the oil on all sides for 10 minutes and set aside.

Soften the onions for 8 minutes, add the garlic, paprika and paste for 1 minute, then the stock and bay leaf. Return the brisket with the carrots, cover tightly and braise for 3.5 hours until very tender.
Rest for 20 minutes, slice across the grain and serve with the sauce and parsley.
notes: Uses no flour, grains or leavening, but check packaged ingredients such as stock for Passover certification if you observe it.
Food safety: braise until very tender and well above 75°C; cool quickly, refrigerate within 2 hours and eat within 3 days.

recipes.title: Easter Roast Lamb with Garlic, Rosemary and Spring Vegetables
recipes.summary: A classic Easter lamb leg roasted pink with asparagus and baby carrots.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Stud the lamb with garlic and rub with rosemary, oil and zest.
Roast with the potato and carrots for 90 minutes until a thermometer reads 60°C for medium or 70°C for well done. Add the asparagus for the last 10 minutes.
Rest the lamb for 20 minutes and slice.
notes: Spring vegetables suit Easter in the northern hemisphere; in Australia, use autumn veg like pumpkin.

Food safety: whole cuts of lamb can be served medium (60°C) when the outside is seared; cook to 70°C for children, the elderly and pregnancy. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 3 days.

recipes.title: Easter Ham and Egg Pie with Parsley
recipes.summary: A shortcrust-free, puff-topped pie of ham, egg and parsley.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and line a pie dish with one sheet of pastry.
Layer the ham and parsley in the base, crack in 6 eggs, and pour over the cream mixed with the remaining 2 beaten eggs, parmesan and pepper.
Cover with the second sheet, seal, cut a slit and bake for 40 minutes until puffed and golden and the egg is set in the centre.
notes: Contains gluten, dairy and egg.
Food safety: cook until the egg is fully set; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Iftar Chicken and Rice with Apricots and Almonds
recipes.summary: A gentle, nourishing iftar main of spiced chicken, rice, sweet apricots and toasted almonds.
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil for 6 minutes, add the onion and spices for 4 minutes until soft.
Stir in the rice, stock and apricots, cover and cook gently for 20 minutes until the rice is tender and the chicken reaches 75°C.
Toast the almonds in a dry pan for 2 minutes until golden and scatter over with the parsley.
notes: Made with halal chicken if required. Contains nuts.
Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C at the thickest part with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Iftar Red Lentil Soup with Lemon and Spiced Lamb Fatayer
recipes.summary: A comforting lentil soup served with small pastry pockets of spiced lamb.
steps: Simmer the lentils, onion, carrot, cumin and stock for 25 minutes until the lentils are soft, blend smooth and add the lemon.
Fry the lamb, onion and allspice in the oil for 8 minutes until browned with no pink left. Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan).
Cut the dough into 12 rounds, fill, pinch into triangles and bake for 15 minutes until golden. Serve with the soup.
notes: Contains gluten. Made with halal lamb if required.
Food safety: lamb mince must reach 75°C with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Iftar Grilled Fish with Chermoula and Saffron Rice
recipes.summary: Firm white fish grilled with a fresh coriander and cumin chermoula over saffron rice.
steps: Blend the coriander, parsley, garlic, cumin, paprika, lemon and oil into a chermoula and spoon half over the fish.
Cook the rice with the saffron in 3 cups of water for 12 minutes until tender.
Grill the fish for 5 minutes each side until opaque and flaking, and serve with the remaining chermoula over the rice.
notes: Contains fish.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

recipes.title: Picnic Halloumi and Roast Vegetable Frittata Squares
recipes.summary: A portable frittata of roasted vegetables and halloumi, cut into squares for the picnic basket.
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan) and line a 20cm by 30cm tin. Roast the zucchini, capsicum and onion with the oil for 15 minutes until soft.
Whisk the eggs, milk, halloumi, basil and salt and stir in the vegetables, then pour into the tin.
Bake for 25 minutes until puffed and set in the centre. Cool and cut into squares.
notes: Contains egg and dairy. Keep cold in a cooler bag.
Food safety: cook until the egg is set; keep chilled below 5°C and eat within 2 hours of leaving the fridge; refrigerate leftovers and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Layered Chicken, Corn and Black Bean Enchilada Bake for a Crowd
recipes.summary: A layered, make-ahead enchilada bake with shredded chicken, corn, beans and cheese that travels well.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Mix the chicken, beans, corn and 1 cup of the sauce.
Layer tortillas, chicken mixture and cheese in a large dish, three times, and pour over the remaining sauce.
Bake for 30 minutes until bubbling and golden. Serve with sour cream and coriander.
notes: Contains dairy.
Food safety: chicken must be cooked to 75°C before shredding; reheat until steaming hot and refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

recipes.title: Potluck Sesame Noodle Salad with Edamame and Cucumber
recipes.summary: A cold noodle salad with a creamy sesame dressing that travels beautifully.
steps: Boil the soba for 5 minutes until tender, drain and rinse under cold water. Cook the edamame in boiling water for 3 minutes until bright green.
Whisk the tahini, soy, vinegar, sesame oil, maple syrup and 1/4 cup of water until smooth.
Toss everything together with the dressing and sprinkle with the sesame seeds.
notes: Contains gluten, soy and sesame. Use 100% buckwheat soba and tamari for gluten-free.

recipes.title: Potluck Baked Ziti with Italian Sausage and Spinach
recipes.summary: A hearty baked pasta for a crowd with sausage, tomato, spinach and melting mozzarella.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Boil the penne for 8 minutes until almost tender and drain.
Brown the sausage and onion for 8 minutes until cooked through with no pink, add the garlic and tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted.
Toss the pasta with the sauce and ricotta, tip into a dish, top with the cheeses and bake for 25 minutes until golden and bubbling.
notes: Contains gluten and dairy.
Food safety: sausage must reach 75°C with no pink; reheat until steaming hot and refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

recipes.title: Picnic Chicken and Vegetable Hand Pies
recipes.summary: Handheld puff pastry pies with chicken, corn and carrot that are good cold.
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil for 5 minutes, add the onion and carrot for 5 minutes, stir in the flour, then the stock and corn and simmer for 5 minutes until thick. Cool completely.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Cut the pastry into 8 squares, fill, fold over, crimp and brush with egg.
Bake for 25 minutes until puffed and golden and the filling is steaming.
notes: Contains gluten and egg.
Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C at the thickest part with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.
